args.message:
Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion when
parsing deeply nested arrays, high severity). Upgrade to 2.9.4, the
fixed version in the 2.x line.

args.head: upgrade-fastjson-2.9.4
args.title: Upgrade fastjson 2.8.0 -> 2.9.4 (fixes CVE-2026-31337)
args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 in `requirements.txt` to address **CVE-2026-31337**.

## Security
- **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays in fastjson.
- Affected versions: `<2.9.4` and `>=3.0.0 <3.1.0`.
- Fixed in: 2.9.4 / 3.1.0. This PR applies the minimal fix within the current 2.x line (2.9.4), avoiding a major-version jump to 3.x.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878 passed.

## Reviewer
- @alex
